title.en: All leads: filter, sort and saved views
title.hi: All leads: filter, sort aur saved views
title.mr: All leads: filter, sort aani saved views

description.en: All leads in Sales X-Ray: a list that loads as you scroll, Filter and sort by follow-up, last contact or name, filter chips, saved Views, and Select to act on many leads at once.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray mein All leads: scroll karte hi load hone wali list, follow-up, last contact ya naam se Filter aur sort, filter chips, saved Views, aur Select se ek saath kai leads pe kaam.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhle All leads: scroll karta load honari list, follow-up, last contact kinva naavane Filter aani sort, filter chips, saved Views, aani Select ne ekdam anek leads var kaam.

names.Can I show you in 10 minutes how: Can I quickly show you how

say.en: In this video: All leads, and finding any lead in seconds.
say.hi: इस video में: All leads, और कोई भी lead seconds में ढूंढना.
say.mr: या video मध्ये: All leads, आणि कुठलाही lead काही seconds मध्ये शोधणं.

latn.hi: Is video mein: All leads, aur koi bhi lead seconds mein dhoondhna.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye: All leads, aani kuthlahi lead kahi seconds madhye shodhna.

say.en: Next: My work, and quick notes.
say.hi: अगले video में: My work, और quick notes.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: My work, आणि quick notes.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: My work, aur quick notes.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: My work, aani quick notes.

say.en: Hundreds of leads? Find any one in seconds.
say.hi: सैकड़ों leads? कोई भी seconds में ढूंढिए.
say.mr: शेकडो leads? कुठलाही काही seconds मध्ये शोधा.

latn.hi: Saikdon leads? Koi bhi seconds mein dhoondhiye.
latn.mr: Shekdo leads? Kuthlahi kahi seconds madhye shodha.

say.en: All leads is your whole list. It loads more as you scroll, so even hundreds of leads open fast.
say.hi: All leads में आपकी पूरी list है. Scroll करते ही और leads load होते हैं, तो सैकड़ों leads भी जल्दी खुलते हैं.
say.mr: All leads मध्ये तुमची पूर्ण list आहे. Scroll करताच आणखी leads load होतात, म्हणजे शेकडो leads पण पटकन उघडतात.

latn.hi: All leads mein aapki poori list hai. Scroll karte hi aur leads load hote hain, toh saikdon leads bhi jaldi khulte hain.
latn.mr: All leads madhye tumchi poorna list aahe. Scroll kartach aankhi leads load hotat, mhanje shekdo leads pan patkan ughadtat.

say.en: Add a lead right at the top: type a name, or paste rows from a sheet.
say.hi: सबसे ऊपर से lead add कीजिए: नाम लिखिए, या sheet से rows paste कीजिए.
say.mr: सगळ्यात वरून lead add करा: नाव लिहा, किंवा sheet मधून rows paste करा.

latn.hi: Sabse upar se lead add kijiye: naam likhiye, ya sheet se rows paste kijiye.
latn.mr: Saglyat varun lead add kara: naav liha, kinva sheet madhun rows paste kara.

say.en: Tap Filter to search and sort.
say.hi: Search और sort के लिए Filter दबाइए.
say.mr: Search आणि sort साठी Filter दाबा.

latn.hi: Search aur sort ke liye Filter dabaiye.
latn.mr: Search aani sort saathi Filter daba.

say.en: Search by name, company, city or phone.
say.hi: नाम, company, city या phone से search कीजिए.
say.mr: नाव, company, city किंवा phone ने search करा.

latn.hi: Naam, company, city ya phone se search kijiye.
latn.mr: Naav, company, city kinva phone ne search kara.

say.en: Sort by next follow-up, last contact, name or newest. And filter, like only the late ones.
say.hi: Next follow-up, last contact, नाम या newest से sort कीजिए. और filter भी, जैसे सिर्फ late वाले.
say.mr: Next follow-up, last contact, नाव किंवा newest ने sort करा. आणि filter पण, जसं फक्त late वाले.

latn.hi: Next follow-up, last contact, naam ya newest se sort kijiye. Aur filter bhi, jaise sirf late wale.
latn.mr: Next follow-up, last contact, naav kinva newest ne sort kara. Aani filter pan, jasa fakta late vale.

say.en: Sort and filter, any way you like.
Filters that are on show as chips. Tap a chip's cross to clear it.
say.hi: जो filters on हैं, वो chips में दिखते हैं. Chip का cross दबाइए, filter हट जाएगा.
say.mr: जे filters on आहेत, ते chips मध्ये दिसतात. Chip चा cross दाबा, filter निघून जाईल.

latn.hi: Jo filters on hain, woh chips mein dikhte hain. Chip ka cross dabaiye, filter hat jaayega.
latn.mr: Je filters on aahet, te chips madhye distat. Chip cha cross daba, filter nighun jaail.

say.en: Use a filter often? Save it as a View, like Mine in Pune, and switch in a tap.
say.hi: कोई filter बार बार लगाते हैं? उसे View बनाकर save कीजिए, जैसे Mine in Pune, और एक tap में switch कीजिए.
say.mr: एखादा filter वारंवार लावता? तो View म्हणून save करा, जसं Mine in Pune, आणि एका tap मध्ये switch करा.

latn.hi: Koi filter baar baar lagate hain? Use View banakar save kijiye, jaise Mine in Pune, aur ek tap mein switch kijiye.
latn.mr: Ekhada filter varanvar laavta? To View mhanun save kara, jasa Mine in Pune, aani eka tap madhye switch kara.

say.en: Tap Select to pick many leads, then Actions: give them to a person, or send a WhatsApp template.
say.hi: Select दबाकर कई leads चुनिए, फिर Actions: उन्हें किसी को दीजिए, या WhatsApp template भेजिए.
say.mr: Select दाबून बरेच leads निवडा, मग Actions: ते कोणाला तरी द्या, किंवा WhatsApp template पाठवा.

latn.hi: Select dabakar kai leads chuniye, phir Actions: unhe kisi ko dijiye, ya WhatsApp template bhejiye.
latn.mr: Select dabun bare leads nivda, mag Actions: te konala tari dya, kinva WhatsApp template pathva.

say.hi: कई चुनिए, एक बार में काम.

latn.hi: Kai chuniye, ek baar mein kaam.
